text: Semantic decode surface is readRaw, readAs with a closed caller-visible conversion policy, readScaledFloat, readScaledDouble, and exact readLabels. Raw UInt8 uses Short because Ravel has no unsigned dtype; Int16/Int32/Float32/Float64 retain Short/Int/Float/Double. Labels canonicalize to exact Long categories and label writes require an integral dtype plus RejectLossy. A zero NIfTI slope disables both slope and intercept scaling.
